svg.title: A hand-drawn style black ink sketch on white of a sitting cat beside an open box with a small spark of light inside, with the word malfluencers lettered above in a sketchy hand-drawn style
svg.desc: Line art illustration: white background, black ink strokes throughout, the word malfluencers hand-lettered large at the top with a wavy underline, below it a sketched cat with round head, triangular ears, whiskers, a simple curved mouth and a curled tail sitting beside a sketched open box with cross-hatched shading inside and a small star-shaped spark of light representing Schrodinger's cat, alive
